text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is the perfect opportunity
for
Симболи Рудольф and I to sharpen up
for the Kikuka
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ideally, we should be taking this
opportunity to
focus all our efforts on
our own training, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Looking good, everybody! Once you've
caught
your breath, we'll try a
200-meter dash.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Y-yes, President!
text_block_list.name: Students

text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer. I was just helping these
fine
students with their training.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
They have not yet been assigned their
own
trainers, so I thought I might lend
my assistance.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
True enough, Симболи Рудольф could
probably give
as good a lesson as the
average trainer, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You're wondering whether I'm neglecting
my own
training, aren't you? It's written
on your face.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Not to worry, I fully intend to adhere to
our
schedule.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I have calculated everything to
perfection. I've
even incorporated a
buffer in case of
emergencies.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Do you have any other questions?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Splendid. Now, I think that's a long
enough break.
I ought to get back to
training.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
A little while after we finish our session, I
catch
sight of Симболи Рудольф once again
leading a class
of younger students.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон tells me that you are
frustrated by
your performance in the
scrimmages. Is that
correct?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Th-that's right...
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
I've been getting great times during
practice. If
I'd been able to match them
in the last
scrimmage, I would've won...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
In that case, your issue sounds quite
clear.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: You think so?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
It's exceedingly rare to replicate one's
practice
times in a real race.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The only way to close that gap is by
acclimating
yourself to the race
environment. What you lack
is
experience.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I have a suggestion to help you better

understand.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
How would you like to run with me, here
and
now?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: I... I'd love to!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin and Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Haha. I'm glad to hear it. Shall we get
started?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Even after nighttime rolls around and
most of the
students are enjoying leisure
time, there's no rest
for the weary.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Sorry for taking up so much of your time,
Prez.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it. Any concern of the
academy's
is a concern of mine.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I am simply glad to help my fellow
students. Had I
been denied that
opportunity, I would've been

devastated.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you certainly never change, do
you?
Anyway, I ought to skedaddle.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure some darling ponies are
overworking
themselves somewhere, and
I have to go find
them!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Now that I've seen for myself that
Симболи Рудольф
is managing her schedule
just fine, there's no
reason to be
concerned... but I can't quite shake a

nagging unease.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The next day...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I realize this is sudden, but may I ask
your
thoughts on something?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Very good. I was trying to brainstorm
some ways
to get the most out of
summer camp, you see...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: You mean on top of our regular training?

text_block_list.text: Precisely. Bonus training, if you will.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Over the past few days, it has become
clear to me
that I have more to learn if I
wish to conquer the
Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Can you think of anything we could add
to our
current schedule?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Her commitment is impressive, but I
can't
recommend taking on any more
physical training.
Instead I suggest...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Take a break now and then.

text_block_list.text:
That... wasn't exactly what I had in mind.
Perhaps
I was a little too roundabout...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: Diet matters as much as practice.

text_block_list.text:
I am aware. But that isn't why you're
suggesting
this, is it?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You think more exertion would do more
harm
than good, don't you?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You think too little of me. You and Air
Groove
both.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I have told you both of the dream I
aspire to. You
know that attaining it will
require extraordinary
effort.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The path I have chosen requires me to
push
myself beyond my limits. I thought
you
understood that.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Do you truly think I am so weak as to
falter at this
hurdle?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I apologize. That was thoughtless of me.
You are
not the target of my
frustrations.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Clearly, I must become stronger if I don't
want
others to worry about me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Leave me be for now, Trainer. Let me
ponder this
alone first.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
For now, I will take your advice. I'll be
sure to
have a hearty meal tonight.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for the trouble. Please excuse
me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I watch her walk away, her lonely figure
stolidly
refusing any encouragement or
comfort...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:

I was a little too roundabout...

forced to.

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

I watch her walk away, her lonely figure
stolidly
refusing any encouragement or
comfort...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And I can't even open my mouth to stop
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
